title: An acyclic K-flat complex tensors acyclically with every complex
statement: Let O be a sheaf of commutative rings on a site. If K is an acyclic K-flat cochain complex of O-modules, then for every cochain complex F of O-modules, the direct-sum total tensor complex Tot(F ⊗_O K) is acyclic. The tensor product and K-flatness are the existing constructions of def-pc-kflat-complex. No boundedness or flatness of the terms of F is required.

source.place: Tags 06Y0 and 06YT; K-flat resolution from Tag 06YS

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution r : P → F using lem-pc-kflat-resolution. Its cone is acyclic by the quasi-isomorphism cone criterion. K-flatness of K makes Tot(Cone(r) ⊗ K) acyclic. Tensor-cone comparison then shows that Tot(r ⊗ id_K) is a quasi-isomorphism.

K-flatness of P applied to acyclic K gives acyclicity of Tot(K ⊗ P). Construct the bicomplex braiding from module braidings using HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents twice; its naturality in each direction follows from braiding naturality. Totalize this isomorphism and compose with Mathlib HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorFlipIso to obtain the signed symmetry Tot(K ⊗ P) ≅ Tot(P ⊗ K). Transport acyclicity across it, then across the quasi-isomorphism from the first step using quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt in each degree.
